subject: error in deployApp(), possibly due to directory size

messages.author: 53536688530f7af4
messages.subject: error in deployApp(), possibly due to directory size
parts:
Hi everyone

I'm having a problem uploading my app to shinyapps.io with the deployApp() function. After an extremely long time of waiting for the app to upload, I got an error that stated that it did not work (printed below). 

When I re-ran deployApp(), it told me that it had worked and deployed, but the deployed app bundle has no data in one of the directories, which stores all of the data. This is a large directory, ~ 2.8 GB, because I have a lot of biology data that I would like to share. 

Can anyone please suggest what may be causing this problem? I have read in some places that the size limit for applications uploads may be 1 GB, but I haven't yet found that on the shinyapps.io website. Is this true and is it the reason for my problems? If so, would upgrading to one of the other plans prevent this problem? I'm also open to other solutions if you have suggestions. 

Best
Andrew

messages.subject: Re: error in deployApp(), possibly due to directory size
parts:
The maximum bundle size is 1 GB for free and starter, and 5 GB for basic, standard and professional.

If your bundle is larger than 3 GB, you will need to override rsconnect's default: https://github.com/rstudio/rsconnect/pull/125

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html
